title: Undergraduate Admissions, Class of 2031 (Fall Cycle)
about: Fulbright University Vietnam's Fall Cycle for its undergraduate Class of 2031 opened October 3, 2026 and closes at 5:00 PM on January 26, 2027. Scholarship applicants submit both the admissions and scholarship applications by the same deadline.
requirements: One Admissions Application per applicant for the Class of 2031
Scholarship Application can only be submitted after the Admissions Application, by the same deadline
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for Undergraduate Admissions, Class of 2031 (Fall Cycle) at Fulbright University Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, application deadline 26 Jan 2027. The photo shows the limestone islands and cruise boats of Ha Long Bay, a country photo, not Ho Chi Minh City.
